hyperedges.label: Debounced Auto-Sync Pipeline (event funnel -> queue -> git cycle -> fs bridge)

nodes.label: pollForToken() (device flow step 2)
nodes.rationale: Implements OAuth device grant polling with authorization_pending / slow_down (+5s interval) handling, expiry deadline, and a silent-stop isAborted signal so caller cancellation does not produce stray rejections.

nodes.label: DebugLogger (serialized file logging)
nodes.rationale: Best-effort write chain that never masks the operation being logged; rotates at 512KB; promotes context.code to a top-level field so entries filter by error code without parsing.

nodes.label: getUserRepos()
nodes.rationale: Private-repo filter is applied client-side because the GitHub API forbids combining affiliation and visibility query params; the plugin never syncs to public repositories.

nodes.label: repoHasCommits()
nodes.rationale: GitHub returns 409 'Git Repository is empty' for repos with no commits; a 200 on commits?per_page=1 distinguishes clone-worthy repos from empty ones.

nodes.label: createFsAdapter (DataAdapter -> fs bridge)
nodes.rationale: Strips the absolute vaultPath prefix before calling Obsidian's relative-path DataAdapter. Missing files must throw ENOENT (standard fs semantics) because isomorphic-git callers distinguish missing from empty. rmdir removes recursively so a partial .git left by an interrupted clone can be fully cleaned up.

nodes.label: SyncQueue (debounce + retry)
nodes.rationale: Transient failures are retried with 5s backoff up to MAX_RETRIES=3 so a single network blip never drops an edit; genuine merge conflicts are NOT retried automatically because they require a user decision.

nodes.label: PluginSettings + DEFAULT_SETTINGS + PROTECTED_EXCLUDES
nodes.rationale: PROTECTED_EXCLUDES (.git/**, plugin logs) are backfilled onto saved excludePatterns on every load because saved arrays fully replace defaults - prevents the plugin's own writes from self-triggering sync on installs with old persisted settings. setupInProgress/setupStartedAt coordinate concurrent plugin instances during repository setup.

nodes.label: GitHub OAuth Device Flow
nodes.rationale: Chosen because it needs no server or callback URL; no client secret is generated since secrets must never be embedded in plugin code.

nodes.label: isomorphic-git
nodes.rationale: Pure-JS git engine chosen so sync works on desktop and mobile (iOS/Android) with no native binaries.

nodes.label: fs-adapter.ts
nodes.rationale: Custom adapter wrapping Obsidian's DataAdapter because Obsidian's API works on all platforms; key constraint: never use require('fs') directly so mobile keeps working.

nodes.label: git-sync.ts
nodes.rationale: Core git operations (init/clone/pull/push); key constraint: always pull before push, enforced in git-sync.ts::sync().

nodes.label: queue.ts
nodes.rationale: Debounced sync queue with mutex to prevent race conditions; changes push after ~3 seconds of inactivity.

nodes.label: OAuth App Client ID
nodes.rationale: Registered once and baked into the plugin at build time; precedence: shell env CLIENT_ID, then .env file, then src/constants.ts fallback.

nodes.label: Private GitHub Repo Storage
nodes.rationale: User's own private GitHub repo chosen as storage because it is free, private, and version-controlled; no subscription, no cloud fees, no intermediate server, data never leaves the user's account.

nodes.label: repo OAuth Scope
nodes.rationale: Minimum scope required to create and push to private repositories; without it GitHub only allows access to public repos.

nodes.label: requestUrl HTTP API
nodes.rationale: Uses Obsidian's built-in requestUrl because it bypasses CORS and works on mobile; constraint: never use fetch or axios.

nodes.label: Conflict Resolution UI
nodes.rationale: Side-by-side view shown automatically when two devices edit the same file before either has synced, letting users pick Keep Mine / Keep Theirs / Open in Editor.

nodes.label: Multiple Vaults per Account
nodes.rationale: Each vault gets its own separate repo; default repo name derived from the vault name so the right repo is picked up automatically on every device.

nodes.label: Default Excluded Patterns
nodes.rationale: Workspace files excluded because they change frequently, are device-specific, and do not need to be shared.

nodes.label: Sanitized Rotating Debug Log
nodes.rationale: Rotating log (max 512 KB) with tokens, secrets and access codes redacted before writing so it is safe to share.

nodes.label: Local Token Storage
nodes.rationale: Access token stored only in Obsidian's local plugin data (data.json) on each device and never leaves the device except to talk directly to GitHub's API; constraint: never store the token anywhere other than this.saveData(); revocable via GitHub Authorized OAuth Apps.

nodes.label: Pull on Open
nodes.rationale: Every device pulls latest changes when Obsidian opens so the vault is always up-to-date.

nodes.label: Repository Setup Flow (create/clone/init+push decision tree)
nodes.rationale: Credentials are persisted immediately at setup start so a plugin reload during slow OAuth/repo setup can restore the connection; rolled back to previous settings on failure. Clone-vs-init+push is decided by checking whether the remote has commits (repoHasCommits) instead of swallowing clone errors, so real auth/network failures stay visible.

nodes.label: Auto-Sync Event Funnel (5s aggregation window)
nodes.rationale: All vault modify/create/delete/rename events funnel through one counter (blocked/filtered/enqueued) logged once per 5s window to avoid log flooding on mobile.

nodes.label: Mobile Vault Path Handling
nodes.rationale: Mobile adapters may expose basePath even though their API expects vault-relative paths; an empty vaultPath makes isomorphic-git operate from the adapter root, never the exposed filesystem path.

nodes.label: Six-Step Sync Cycle (stage/commit/fetch/merge/conflict-detect/push)
nodes.rationale: Each step is individually guarded so one failure cannot cascade. Remote head is resolved from refs/remotes/origin/main because isomorphic-git fetch never writes FETCH_HEAD (previously made every fetch look failed). Only merge-reported MergeConflictError filepaths count as conflicts - statusMatrix stage columns are not conflict markers and previously produced phantom conflicts that blocked every push on mobile.

nodes.label: Custom Git HTTP Client (requestUrl-based)
nodes.rationale: isomorphic-git is wired to Obsidian requestUrl so git transport works on mobile and bypasses CORS; credentials are supplied via onAuth because isomorphic-git strips them from remote URLs.

nodes.label: Stable Error Code Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Every failure reaching the user or debug log maps to a stable machine-readable code, friendly message and suggested action; raw technical detail is preserved separately for the debug log and persisted sync outcome so only the friendly surface reaches users.

nodes.label: Log Sanitization / Secret Redaction
nodes.rationale: Tokens, passwords, device codes, authorization headers and file body/content keys are redacted before writing so bug-report logs can be shared safely.

nodes.label: Sync Contracts (SyncStatus, ConnectionState, ConflictFile, SyncResult, SyncOutcome)
nodes.norm_label: sync contracts (syncstatus, connectionstate, conflictfile, syncresult, syncoutcome)

nodes.label: Build-time CLIENT_ID Injection
nodes.rationale: process.env.CLIENT_ID is defined at bundle time from dotenv/env (CI uses repo secret), keeping the OAuth app id configurable per environment while falling back to the source default locally.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions Release Workflow
nodes.rationale: Tag push triggers npm install + production build with CLIENT_ID from repo secrets, then publishes main.js and manifest.json via softprops/action-gh-release.
